description: expected verdicts for the paracraft benchmark test set. each entry declares the model file, the family it belongs to, and the expected verdict per named rule set version. the harness measures; this manifest records what the harness should find. a rule set that produces unexpected verdicts on the pathological family is wrong, not the pieces.
notes: verdicts reflect the constraints in the named rule set version, not physical castability.
profile-001 v0.4.0 is the active rule set. v0.2.0 / v0.3.0 references in older commits are historical.
manifest entries gain an ops array in v0.4.0 listing the operation types each model exercises. the harness uses these for op-keyed report grouping; they do not change verdict logic.

engrave-recess family added in v0.4.0: text cut via difference() at sourced depths (0.3 mm and 0.5 mm per evid-feat-003, evid-engrave-001) on thin (1.0 mm) and safe (2.0 mm) base plates. thin models fire ctr-wall-001 on the remaining wall; safe models pass.
all wall-ladder, feature-ladder, size-family, and symbolic-stress models compile to geometry the five ready measurements can evaluate; bounding_box and minimum_wall_thickness are fully measured.

hollow-shell models all contain hollow components (nested inner cavity); ctr-hollow-001 (severity error) in profile-001 v0.2.0 blocks all of them as invalid regardless of shell thickness or drain holes.
pathological p-003 contains a trapped inner component; ctr-nested-001 (severity error) blocks it as invalid.
all models have manifold geometry (ctr-mesh-001 passes); this is a property of correct openscad difference/union operations.
wall-ladder rungs at 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 mm trigger ctr-wall-001 warning (< 0.8 mm threshold from src-0010 cooksongold, src-0001 materialise); rungs at 0.8 mm and above pass.
ctr-thick-001 and ctr-wall-002/003 and ctr-feat-001 etc. are unmeasured by the five-measurement scope; overall status is manual_review when any constraint is unmeasured but no error fires.
symbolic-stress variant 2 (join_width_thin 0.6 mm) and claddagh crown tines (0.7 mm) trigger ctr-wall-001 warning.
size-family rings all have 1.0 mm walls, which pass ctr-wall-001 (>= 0.8 mm).
pathological p-001a gap 0.1 mm triggers ctr-clear-001 warning; p-001b gap 0.4 mm passes.
pathological p-004 slab 0.3 mm wall triggers ctr-wall-001 warning.
pathological p-005 band at exactly 0.8 mm passes ctr-wall-001.

size-family ring diameters are sourced from the gia 4cs ring size chart (src-0023, accessed 2026-10-04): us sizes 3 to 13 map to 14.10 to 22.20 mm inside diameter. gia rounds to one decimal; a second chart source is desirable before these diameters are treated as tight tolerances. the size-9 value corrects the previously flagged 18.89 mm nominal. expected verdicts (1.0 mm wall passes ctr-wall-001 at every size) are unaffected by the diameter correction. the committed report.json size-family stl hashes predate this table change and refresh on the next harness run.

feature-ladder text sub-family uses font liberation sans, bundled with the openscad 2021.01 docker image (openscad/openscad:2021.01). verified headless under that image by the benchmark harness run of 2026-10-04: all three text models compiled with plausible glyph geometry (1284 facets, 2 volumes, distinct meshes per letter size) and no font warnings.

feature-ladder text sub-family tests three conflicting engraving rules in the same file: cooksongold (src-0010) letter_h=0.6 mm extrude=0.3 mm, sculpteo (rule-digest) letter_h=1.5 mm extrude=0.5 mm, hi3dp (rule-digest) letter_h=1.0 mm extrude=0.2 mm. verdicts are per rule set.
